text:
Olivia (AE): Quick heads up — HelixCorp legal asked for our SOC 2 report + a bridge-letter or temporary evidence window before signing. They want a POC this week. Can we provide anything sooner than a full report? Need NDA routing too.

Raj (Solutions): For a POC we can do a read-only evidence snapshot (presigned S3) with redacted extracts. Pricing Q: if they want Dedicated for the POC, can we offer a short trial rate? @Olivia

Sasha (SecOps): We can produce a SOC 2 Type II extract (control narratives + sampled evidence items) as a redacted package. We don't hand over full raw logs. Turnaround usually ~48h to assemble + watermarking. This requires an NDA + our evidence-handling addendum.

Laura (Legal): I'll route the NDA. Please send me HelixCorp's security contact email. We'll use our temp-evidence addendum and the signed bridge-letter template. Reminder: a bridge letter confirms conditions at a point in time and is not a substitute for the full report.

Olivia (AE): Helix contact is anna@helixcorp.com. They're pushing for POC kickoff Fri. Can we realistically turn this around in 48h if they sign NDA today?

Sasha (SecOps): 48h is tight but doable if we scope to infra + access-control samples only. Ask them to confirm which control families they care about (e.g., CC6, CC7). We'll provide a presigned link with expiry and watermarking. Example presign command we use internally: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/helix-snapshot.zip --expires-in 604800`

Raj (Solutions): On pricing, we can offer a 2-week Dedicated eval at 50% list (usage cap applies). If they want production SLAs that's standard pricing. I can draft the eval quote once Olivia confirms scope.

BridgeBot: BridgeBot: NDA signed by HelixCorp received (signed_at: 1958002480). Routing to Legal. :white_check_mark:

Laura (Legal): Got the signed NDA. I'll attach to the ticket and send the bridge-letter template to Olivia now. Once NDA is confirmed Sasha can start packaging the snapshot. cc @Raj for the eval quote.

Olivia (AE): :thumbsup: I'll ping Anna to confirm control scope and ask them to sign the addendum. Will update thread when I hear back.
